{{Top|leg}}
'''Hoegler''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting of the entry for the [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], Hoegler advised readers to note underestimate the usefulness of a datapad, even going so far as mention that the time:date function could be used as a makeshift countdown [[Detonator/Legends|detonator]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
